item.title: BPL Crisis, Political Backlash, Little Miss Galaxy
item.ns0:title: BPL Crisis, Political Backlash, Little Miss Galaxy
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, Prime Minister Philip Davis faces a barrage of questions over the worsening power crisis and the curious silence of the nation's Energy Minister. Meanwhile, a major union battle erupts in the education sector as shocking allegations of illegal registration are/were hurled just weeks before the school bell rings. Two police officers secure a massive legal victory following their wrongful detention in a historic drug bust, while the high-stakes search continues for a missing Eleuthera woman. Plus, we take you to Fort Charlotte where frustrated vendors say repeated break-ins are threatening to run them out of business.
